title: Notice: Monitoring of the commitments given by IAG to the European Commission in relation to its acquisition of bmi
summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is monitoring the commitments given by International Consolidated Airlines Group, S.A (IAG) to the European Commission (the ‘Commission’) in relation to its acquisition of bmi on 30 March 2012 (Case No COMP/M.6447) (the ‘Commitments’).

title: Vivisol / Air Liquide (home oxygen services business) merger inquiry
summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is investigating the anticipated acquisition by Dolby Medical Home Respiratory Care Limited (Vivisol) of Air Liquide Healthcare Limited’s home oxygen services business.
